mapper.sql: K.KeywrdSeq, K.KeywrdName, K.KeywrdSect, K.ShopCode, S.ShopName AS ShopName, K.State, K.Remark, K.RegistId, K.RegistName, CAST(K.RegistDate AS CHAR) AS RegistDate, K.ChangeId, K.ChangeName, CAST(K.ChangeDate AS CHAR) AS ChangeDate
FROM shopwizard.tOrdOrderKeywrd K LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = K.ShopCode

if.test: pKeywrdSeq != null and pKeywrdSeq != '' and pKeywrdSeq.toString().matches('^[0-9]+$')

mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE K.State = 1 ORDER BY K.ShopCode, K.KeywrdSect, K.KeywrdName
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOrdOrderKeywrd SET KeywrdName = #{keywrdName}, KeywrdSect = #{keywrdSect}, ShopCode = #{shopCode}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE KeywrdSeq = #{keywrdSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode}
